notes: a hood is not built into an opening
p.144: wall hoods should be at least as wide as the cooking surface - 1219 over a 1219 range satisfies it exactly, with nothing to spare

p.144: a Pro 27in deep wall hood is RECOMMENDED over a range with a charbroiler or griddle, and DF48650C/S/P is the charbroiler model - recorded, not acted on: this is a specification question for Andriy, not a drawing one
duct 254 round, vertical discharge on the 24in deep wall hood; a horizontal discharge kit exists through a dealer (p.144)

envelope.note: 24in DEEP WALL HOOD, read off the p.141 figure and its WIDTH table. The body is a WEDGE, not a box: the top face runs 305 back from the wall at full height and then chamfers down and forward to a front face 102 tall at the 610 front edge. The envelope is what a reservation keeps clear (domain rule 4), so the chamfer is recorded and not drawn.

mounting.source: wolf-design-guide.pdf rev 7/2025 p.144 and the figure on p.145
mounting.note: printed as a RANGE - 30in (762) to 36in (914) from the BOTTOM OF THE HOOD to the countertop, for all Pro hoods except the outdoor wall hood. A range is a decision, not a constant, so nothing may default it: the same argument B6 settled for the run gap's depth.
